text: Stop operating blind. Follow every trip, protect profitability and decide from the costs and deliveries that actually happened.
In emerging, fast-growing markets, unsuitable tools push teams toward fragmented communication and manual processes that erode profitability.
Without a central execution layer, every trip becomes a blind spot.
Little visibility over trips and deliveries.
Margins and profitability are hard to calculate per route.
Dependence on unstructured personal WhatsApp exchanges.
Approximate tracking of fuel, maintenance and driver advances.
Scattered data that cannot be analyzed globally.
Datakö Fleet replaces scattered spreadsheets with one operational foundation, keeping every operation connected to its cost and margin.
Roadmaps, progress and statuses followed from departure to delivery.
Trucks, drivers, routes and depots centralized for each trip.
Customer billing and execution costs connected to calculate each trip’s net margin.
Fuel, tolls, driver advances and other critical expenses traced.
Field issues reported and preventive maintenance cycles planned.
Clean data for billing and integration into management systems.
Fleet turns WhatsApp into an execution terminal: teams validate steps without installing another app.
Proof, expenses and issues come straight from the field.
The channel already fits mobile habits.
Every answer immediately completes one line of the operation.
The quantity received, confirmed by the customer.
After unloading, the recipient gets a personal link by WhatsApp or email. They declare what they actually received, making discrepancies visible immediately.
A demo delivery has just arrived.
The message is sent automatically at the end of delivery.
One required field, no account to create.
A discrepancy was reported against the declared quantity.
The discrepancy reaches the operator when it happens.
Spot overconsumption, abnormal costs and unjustified expenses.
Connect revenue and actual expenses trip by trip.
Digitize documents and trace sensitive operations.
Handle incidents and disputes during the operation.
Start with visibility, structure execution, then add operational intelligence as maturity grows.
Additional users and Enterprise deployments are available according to the organization. The Sales module is optional on Pro for mixed activities.
An even more complete view of field operations, directly in Datakö Fleet.
Datakö Fleet will progressively integrate GPS and telematics to enrich operational management.
See Fleet with your trips, costs and field constraints.
